newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Cretacico oil sale cancelled again.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Cretacico oil sale cancelled again.

text.p: Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) canceled for the second time Friday the scheduled auction of the Cretacico Sur oil field in western Venezuela after no bids were received, a PDVSA spokesman said.

Operating rights were to be sold as part of Venezuela's third oil contracts auction round which has attracted some $2 billion in bids over the past five days. The Cretacio field was first offered Wednesday.
PDVSA officials said investors were probably deterred by the Cretacico field's size, geological complexity, high level of required investment and lack of time to adequately study the block.
The 784 square km field, discovered in Lake Maracaibo in 1967, currently produces 500 barrels per day from one active well and 30-50 million barrels of proven reserves.
A total of 131 companies have competed for 20 contracts offered this week with the winners determined purely by the size of their bids.
